candidate_claim: Not a candidate report. Lane-B audit D01-S01, RC-03.
candidate_verdict: UPHELD. An arrow chain in a memorisation skeleton reads as descending legal force, and known_traps.md #53 had already struck the same ladder down in QB9_G. A skeleton is the most dangerous place for it: it is designed to be recalled without re-derivation.
authority: HELD - known_traps.md #53, on VCLT 1969 Art.2(1)(a): a treaty is an international agreement governed by international law 'whatever its particular designation'. Convention and Protocol are titles reflecting treaty practice, not tiers. HELD - the 1988 SOLAS and Load Line Protocols are themselves treaty law and are the HSSC instruments, which is the same fact RC-01 turns on. Mandatory Codes take their force from the binding instrument that incorporates them - ISM and ISPS through SOLAS IX and XI-2, IMSBC through VI/1-2. Resolutions have no single legal effect: SOLAS Art.VIII(b) annex amendments are adopted BY MSC resolution, while an Assembly resolution under IMO Convention Art.15(j) is a recommendation.
